name: toolcrib
description: Per-category slice of component-manifest.json's "components" array (category: Containers), for on-demand detail without loading the full manifest. See component-manifest.json for themeSystem/zIndexScale/eventBus and cross-category data.

components.name: AppShell

layout.description:
`'default'` stacks children vertically (the original behavior).
`'sidebar-left'`/`'sidebar-right'` separate out `AppShell.Header` (if
present, stays full-width on top) and lay out everything else —
`AppShell.Sidebar` and `AppShell.Main`, written in either order — as a
row, with the sidebar on the named side.

overrides.description: Per-instance override for Header/Main/Sidebar padding density. Since AppShell is meant to render once, this mostly exists for consistency with other components — the global Theme Editor control is the more typical way to change this.

components.constraints: Intended to be rendered once, at the root of the component tree
components.description: Full-viewport root layout frame with Header, Sidebar, and Main slots — the top-level wrapper for an entire app

components.name: Card

layout.description:
Layout mode. `'auto'` enables flex filling (height:100%, flex:1) and activates
automatic corner-squaring via layout domain context (e.g. inside a Splitter).

squareCorners.description: Override which corners are squared off. `'auto'` defers to layout domain context.

overrides.description: Per-instance theme overrides (padding, header style, subtheme).

components.constraints: For a long list/grid of many Cards (default, non-`auto` layout — content-sized, not flex-fill), wrap each Card in `<DeferredContent estimatedHeight={...}>` to defer off-screen ones
components.description: Slot-based container with automatic layout domain corner squaring

components.name: CardSimple

title.description: Title text rendered in the header. Omit to skip the header entirely.

subtitle.description: Secondary text rendered next to the title in the header.

footer.description: Content rendered in the footer area. Omit to skip the footer.

actions.description: Action elements (e.g. buttons) rendered in the footer's right side.

components.description: Token-saving shorthand for simple cards without slot composition

components.name: Collapsible

id.description: Unique identifier for event bus targeting. Auto-generated if omitted.

trigger.description: Clickable header content that toggles the panel.

isOpen.description: Controlled open state. When provided, the component becomes fully controlled.

onOpenChange.description: Callback fired when the panel opens or closes.

disabled.description: If true, the trigger is non-interactive and the panel can't be toggled.

components.description: Single expand/collapse content panel — see Accordion for a data-driven set of panels

components.name: DeferredContent

estimatedHeight.description:
Estimated height in pixels to reserve while this content's real size is
unknown — before it's ever been rendered, or while the browser is
currently skipping it. Only needs to be roughly right: browsers
remember the actual last-rendered height and reuse it for every future
skip (that's what the native `auto` keyword this component always
passes to `contain-intrinsic-height` does), so a wrong guess here only
costs one approximate layout, on this element's very first render.

onVisibilityChange.description:
Called when this content's rendering is skipped or resumed by the
browser — e.g. to pause/resume an expensive child (a video, a live
chart, a canvas animation) while it's off-screen. Optional: most
children don't do continuous work and don't need this.

components.description: Defers layout/paint of off-screen content via native content-visibility, for long lists/grids of many repeated items (e.g. many <Card>s, a long <Accordion>) — not for flex `1 1 0px` fill panels like Splitter.Panel/TabStrip.Panel, which are already always-visible and get no benefit from this

components.name: ScrollArea

orientation.description: Which axis renders a scrollbar. `'both'` also renders the corner patch.

type.description:
When the scrollbar is visible — `'hover'` matches native OS scrollbar
behavior most closely.

maxHeight.description:
Fixed height (e.g. `'20rem'`) for standalone use outside a flex domain.
Omit to fill 100% of the parent instead, the same fill-by-default
convention as `<Content>`.

overrides.description: Per-instance override for the scrollbar thumb's thickness.

components.description: Scrollable container with a themed, cross-browser custom scrollbar

components.name: Sidebar

activeId.description: Currently active item id — renders with `aria-current="page"`.

onItemClick.description: Called when an item is clicked, with that item's id.

collapsed.description: Controlled collapsed (icon-only) state. Omit to let `<Sidebar>` manage it internally via its own built-in toggle button.

defaultCollapsed.description: Initial collapsed state when uncontrolled (`collapsed` omitted).

onCollapsedChange.description: Called whenever collapsed state changes, whether controlled or uncontrolled.

overrides.description: Per-instance override for nav item spacing.

components.description: Vertical nav-item list built on Radix NavigationMenu, with a collapsed icon-only mode

components.name: Splitter

id.description: Unique domain identifier for layout context. Auto-generated if omitted.

orientation.description: Split direction. `'vertical'` = top/bottom panels, `'horizontal'` = left/right panels.

initialSplit.description: Initial percentage allocated to the first (top/left) panel.

minSize.description: Minimum percentage size for either panel to prevent collapsing.

components.description: Resizable two-panel layout with automatic corner-squaring domain

id.description: Unique key for this item, and the value reported via `activeId`/`onItemClick`.

label.description: Label text — hidden (not just visually truncated) while the sidebar is collapsed, so only `icon` remains.

icon.description: Icon rendered before the label. Still shown, alone, in collapsed mode — the only thing collapsed mode has room for.

href.description: Href for this item's link. Omit for a JS-driven item (`onClick`/`onItemClick` only).

disabled.description: If true, this item is not selectable.
